criteria.requirement: The provider-neutral receipt candidate binds complete authenticated source and actual independent execution, rejects self-enrollment and negative-review bypass, and remains disabled with empty executor trust while existing live protections remain unchanged.

Real cryptographic positive/negative fixtures cover altered sources, manifest and wire data, stale or mixed snapshots, self-review, quota versus failure, native formal approval separation and source-bound adapters; paired maintainer documentation accurately states rollout limitations.
